name: Omakase Player
role: Browser review player: frame-index seeks, timeline, markers; a candidate base for review pages
summary: Apache-2.0 JavaScript framework (npm @byomakase/omakase-player 1.3.1) for frame-accurate review UIs: main and sidecar players, multi-track timeline, marker lists, VU meter. Plays HLS and MP4; seekTo takes seconds, frame count or timecode. A person-facing player, not a render tool.
use_when: A review page that must jump to an exact frame or timecode and show markers on a timeline
Frame-index seeks of an MP4 in a browser, checked by what is on screen
avoid_when: Deterministic frame capture of a scene: playwright with a seekable scene
Decoding or inspecting frames in code: mediabunny or ffmpeg-ffprobe
A plain video element is enough for the review page
notes: 2026-11-27: lead said 'pnpm add @byomakase/omakase-player hls.js'; hls.js is a dependency already, and rxjs must be added to the page bundle by the consumer under pnpm. Needs omakase-player.css or the video element has zero size. Ships one dependency from GitHub (smp-imsc, bbc/imscJS) fetched at install. Package is large (19 MB unpacked); bundle with a tool such as esbuild.
2026-11-27: only plain MP4 main media with the CHROMELESS theme was tried. Timeline, markers, sidecar media, HLS and detached control bar are untested.

assessment.rationale: Apache-2.0, npm 1.3.1 modified 2026-11-26. No catalogued tool is a review player. Headless Chromium seeks a plain MP4 by frame index and the screenshot shows the requested frame, so it is a viable building block for plugin PRD P3 review pages; whether P3 adopts a third-party player is still open.

evidence.result: 120-frame 24 fps H.264 MP4 with a 20-bit frame barcode; 14 non-monotonic FRAME_COUNT seeks in Chromium 156.0.8078.4: every screenshot decoded to the requested frame and getCurrentTime(FRAME_COUNT) matched; 0 page errors; duration 5 s.
evidence.scope: Plain MP4 main media, CHROMELESS theme, 150 ms settle wait, macOS arm64. Not HLS, timeline, markers, sidecar, long-GOP or other frame rates.
